messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: Elevated 5xx rate on inference-api-prod (gateway). Alert: 5xx rate 18% over baseline, latency tail rising. Pager level: P1.

alice (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pinging SRE and runtime.

ben (sre): joining. pulling metrics. 5xx spike started ~04:10 UTC, looks correlated with KV cache errors on runtime logs.

sarah (eng-runtime): saw similar in logs — repeated KV prefix lookup failures and 'cache corrupt entry' warnings on shard g12. Could be eviction storm + corruption.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14_03:58 by sarah completed to inference-api-prod (g12/g13). Commit: 9f2b1d. No rollbacks on file.

carlos (support): customer-impact: 12 proxied customers reporting increased errors, 3 big customers (acme, vectra, learnly) seeing ~30% request failures. Support tickets incoming.

ben (sre): grabbing stack traces and kv client logs now. Quick check: memstats show sudden pagein spikes and OOMs on the prefix cache process. Also seeing large eviction bursts: evict_rate ~1.1M prefixes/s on g12.

sarah (eng-runtime): reproducing minimal repro on staging with the same model variant — when prefix cache sees a burst of malformed keys (null bytes) the prefix decoder falls over and returns error which the serving path treats as 500.

alice (oncall): impact: all hosted inference endpoints through gateway v2 -> inference-api-prod. Mitigation priority: (1) stop eviction storm, (2) fail open cache so serving bypasses prefix cache, (3) reduce client-side retry heat.

ben (sre): suggested immediate action: flip feature flag to disable prefix cache decode and serve from origin (KV passthrough). Doing that now:

ben (sre): ```
# feature flag flip
/kfctl flag set --env prod --key runtime.prefix_cache.decode_enabled --value false --who ben
```

ben (sre): flag applied to region g12/g13 via rollout. Confirming: traffic routed, new instances show decode_enabled=false.

sarah (eng-runtime): patch ready to add len checks and defensive parsing for corrupted keys but that will take longer. For now disabling decode avoids the crash path and should drop 5xx quickly.

carlos (support): notifying affected customers: templated message drafted, will send after we confirm error reduction.

alice (oncall): rolling window metrics: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% in last 90s after flag flip. Latency tail improved but still elevated. Continue monitoring.

ben (sre): I see eviction_rate down by 80% after disabling decode; memory pressure easing. However there are still a few nodes with persistent 'cache corruption' logs — I'm going to restart the prefix-cache sidecar on those nodes to clear corrupted in-memory state.

ben (sre): restarting sidecar on g12-node-17 and g12-node-21: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/prefix-cache-g12 --field-selector spec.nodeName=g12-node-17`

deploy-bot: Restart job queued, restart started on g12-node-17.

emily (prod mgr): quick ask for comms: what's our ETA to full recovery and do we need a status update to the broader ops channel?

alice (oncall): ETA: 10-15m to stabilize to normal error rates after restarts and flag. Recommend sending a heads-up to #general and customers after 10m if trend holds.

ben (sre): restarts complete on both nodes. Post-restart logs show sidecars resumed with clean caches. No corruption warnings on restarted hosts.

carlos (support): sending draft to affected customers now, included mitigation steps and a note that we're monitoring for residual errors.

alice (oncall): monitoring: 5xx now at 2.1% and trending down. Gateway timeouts reduced. No new deploys expected.

sarah (eng-runtime): creating a follow-up PR to harden prefix decoder and add checksum validation + defensive fallback to treat malformed entries as cache-miss instead of error. Link will be posted in thread.

ben (sre): post-incident notes for oncall handoff: main cause = corrupted prefix entries combined with eviction storm that exposed a bug in decoder path leading to 500s. Immediate actions: disabled prefix decoder via feature flag (runtime.prefix_cache.decode_enabled=false), restarted affected sidecars, scaled prefix-cache replicas + added a small protective token bucket to limit eviction rate.

alice (oncall): handoff to night shift (ben stays until stable). Handoff summary: current status stable, 5xx <2.5%, mitigation flags applied, sidecars restarted, follow-up work opened: #1234 (runtime: prefix decoder hardening), #1235 (monitoring: add eviction rate alert threshold), #1236 (postmortem).

emily (prod mgr): added customer impact summary to incident ticket: ~12 customers affected, peak error rate 18%, sustained ~5% for ~7m, mitigated to <2.5% within 12m.

alice (oncall): thanks team. I will update incident channel and schedule a 20m postmortem sync tomorrow to finalize RCA. If any new regressions pop up ping me directly. :thumbsup: 

ben (sre): leaving final checks on dashboards for next hour.

incident-bot: Incident P1 1761234567 marked as mitigation-in-progress.

alice (oncall): last note for handoff: artifacts collected -> logs/1761234567/ , kv-dumps/g12/*.gz, and a runnable repro in staging at staging-prefix-corrupt-2026. Links in ticket.

emily (prod mgr): tagging legal/compliance for the larger customers in case they request formal incident report.

alice (oncall): closing thread for now, will re-open if we see any reoccurence.
